lines: Southeast Asian country.
In a luxury hotel in one corner of the city, a party was being held that gathered the city's bigwigs.
Classical music performed by an orchestra brought in from Europe filled the hall, and the guests danced elegantly.
A glamorous gathering of gentlemen and ladies who knew every facet of the city and had amassed wealth and fame beyond measure.
But the pair drawing the most attention were a beautiful foreigner, an “oddity” in this town, and the young man accompanying her.
Audience
(So that's her… the head of that Russian mafia…)
Audience
(The “Hotel Moscow” executive, the scar‑faced Balalaika…)
Me
…Seems like we’re getting a lot of attention, Balalaika.
In a place like this, gazes become a physical pressure that pierces you.
I strained my face, feeling completely out of place, and whispered to her as she gracefully stepped before me.
Balalaika
Ah. Leave me alone, Kotaro. You think I’ve caught a young swallow as a lover or something.
Balalaika
This kind of thing happens often at gatherings like this.
Me
N-no, I think nobody’s really paying attention to me…
The guests’ focus was entirely on her.
A tall beauty wrapped in a sleek party dress.
On one side of her cold, aristocratic face was a horrific burn scar from a former battlefield.
She is Balalaika, the female boss of the Russian “Hotel Moscow” mafia who rules the lawless city of Roanapla.
A woman who suddenly invaded this town, spreading blood and terror.
The looks aimed at me were nothing more than an afterthought compared to her.
Balalaika
Oh, is that so?
Balalaika
Well, more importantly, watch your step so you don’t step on my feet.
Balalaika
Acting flawlessly in a place like this is something us villains need to master.
Balalaika
You came here to learn that, didn’t you?
Me
Y-yes…
She gently admonished me, and I tightened my face and nodded.
Me
(I've gotten a bit used to it... but still, talking to her makes me nervous...)
Even though she smiled gently like this, an unfathomable intensity sent a chill down my spine...
I—Fuuma Kotaro—am a Taimanin who fights demons for justice under orders from the Japanese government.
She, a bona‑fide arch‑villain who has sunk her hands into countless illegal activities in the Southeast Asian waters,
is together with the Russian mafia’s top executive, Balalaika, for a certain reason.
Igawa Asagi
She may be a figure of the underworld now, but as far as I know, she's one of the finest commanders.
Asagi
She knows both the surface and the underside of this world, and she understands more than anyone the futility of rigid 'justice'.
Asagi
So Fuuma, if you follow her and learn her mindset and behavior, you'll gain a lot.
Those were the words of Asagi-sensei, the principal of Gosha Academy and commander of the Taimanin forces.
I heard during the last mission that Asagi-sensei and Balalaika have been acquainted for a long time.
In the past, Asagi-sensei was dispatched by the government to carry out missions in the war‑torn Middle East.
There she met Balalaika, who was then a military commander, and they fought together, forging a friendship.
Now, Balalaika is the top executive of a massive mafia—
Meanwhile, Asagi-sensei is a government‑direct agent—though their positions differ,
they both acknowledge each other's unshakable strength and boldness.
Because of that relationship, Asagi-sensei introduced me to Balalaika,
and as a short‑term apprentice attendant, I'm learning the commander’s conduct and the ins and outs of the underworld by her side.
Me
(I didn’t expect to be thrown into such a battlefield all of a sudden...)
I cast glances around the room, thinking to myself.
The party that Balalaika and I are attending appears at first glance to be a peaceful, genteel gathering of the upper class.
But its true nature is different.
This was the venue for a “handshake” concerning the conflict caused by the unit led by her at Hotel Moscow.
This city is a newly emerging trade hub rapidly developing due to recent influx of foreign capital.
The country has only just democratized after recent political changes, so the legal system hasn't caught up.
Therefore, multiple gang organizations are fighting over the city's interests—.
That's when Balalaika, a senior executive of Hotel Moscow, set her sights on it.
Hotel Moscow overwhelms the local gangs with abundant troops and a ruthlessly cold fighting style,
and within just a few weeks secured half of the city's smuggling profits.
This day's party is a gathering to temporarily “handshake” that conflict.
The party is a glamorous affair with many powerful figures from both the city's surface and underworld.
But beneath it lies a tense, dangerous atmosphere.
Because the local gangs aren't satisfied with this “handshake”.
Me
(Well, it can't end peacefully when we pushed things so forcefully…)
With Hotel Moscow's overwhelming force, the local gangs retreated, losing much of their power and interests.
Through mediation by the city's power brokers, the conflict was temporarily “handshaked”, but that doesn't mean they'll back down.
The usual tactic of the cornered—assassinating Balalaika, who leads Hotel Moscow,
to try to turn the tide in one blow… such ominous rumors were spreading.
Me
Even so, Balalaika, it's nice that the party seems to be ending without any incident.
I whispered to Balalaika as she continued dancing, guiding the inexperienced me.
At this party, there was information that local gangs were secretly targeting her for assassination.
As a senior executive of Hotel Moscow, she rarely appears publicly,
so a party like today is a perfect opportunity.
Knowing that, she came to this place.
If I'm dismissed as being frightened of danger, it would hinder the expansion of our interests.
For newcomers trying to bite into the city's interests, that would be a fatal loss.
Now, showing that I can handle any situation is crucial— that's why I thought so.
Even knowing that, putting it into practice is difficult.
She deliberately exposed herself to danger, an act that could be called reckless bravery.
And—.
Even this minefield-like event is now in its final stage.
Despite my concerns, the party seems poised to end peacefully.
Balalaika
Hehe, that's right... Whether on the battlefield or in bed, I don't like being on the receiving end unilaterally.
Balalaika
I've also taken appropriate measures— you saw it too, Kotaro. So, did you gain anything?
Balalaika whispers as if testing the apprentice me.
Me
Yes. I observed everything step by step.
Balalaika has been implementing various countermeasures to oppose the local gangs' movements.
First, she identified points within the party venue, then surrounding sniper spots, explosives, and ambush positions.
She then had the members of Hotel Moscow thoroughly crush those points.
Furthermore, during the party, she actively interacted with influential figures who also affect the local gangs,
to deter anyone from recklessly targeting her and Hotel Moscow.
These countermeasures should have left the local gangs immobilized, making an assassination difficult.
Me
If we can't finish off Balalaika in the current situation, retaliation is certain. They won't be able to take such a risk.
Me
Even though Hotel Moscow has been whittled down, they still hold most of the interests.
Me
I suppose they'll just retreat, thinking that's enough for now.
Me
...I truly admire you. I think it's a splendid display of skill.
Through force and scheming, Balalaika seized the city's interests in a very short time.
From the chaotic clash among the local gangs, she instantly created a certain order.
Regardless of whether it's right or wrong, there’s no other way to describe it but sheer brilliance.
Balalaika
Oh, I’m honored. To be praised that much by Asagi’s pupil. But—
At that moment, the smile on her face in front of me turned cold and twisted.
Balalaika
Your point is good, but—you're overlooking something. Something very, very serious.
Balalaika
We are always greedy like children. “Half” will never satisfy us.
Me
Eh…?
Overlook…?
When I tilted my head, something suspicious flickered at the edge of my vision.
A faint glint reflected from a room at the top of the building adjacent to the party venue.
Me
(Sniper?! No way!!?)
A chill ran down my spine.
The next instant, my body moved before I could think.
Me
!! Balalaika!!!
Gunfire—.
Audience
Kyaaa!!! What the—! What just happened!?
Shards of falling glass and the ensuing roar of anger and screams.
A sniper shot had been fired.
The bullet from the top of the building had pierced deep into my chest as I moved to shield Balalaika.
Me
Guuuh!?
The pain and heat piercing my chest— the impact sent me sprawling as if rebounded.
Balalaika's subordinate
--Captain, respond immediately! We're being targeted!
Guard
Everyone stay calm! The exit is secured!
The venue was flooded with chaos.
Attendees turned pale and fled in panic, while security and Balalaika’s subordinates raised their voices to restore order.
But amid the confusion, questions filled my mind.
The room at the top of the adjacent building.
That sniper point should have already been eliminated by her orders.
So why was a shot fired from there?
And, as if answering my doubts—
Balalaika
Heh. Sorry, Kotaro. …The one who wanted a “spark” was actually us.
As my hearing faded from the blood loss, her sharp whisper reached my ear.
